title: The Glass Roof
hook: It looks in. The roof is glass.
question: Would you hide in the dark shed, or run for it?
synopsis: The Hush is right behind the last car. Rook hides the train in the old engine shed and puts out every light. But the shed has a glass roof, and the Hush looks in.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: The yard lamps went dark. It's here!
The old engine shed! Get inside!
Close the doors! Walls hide us.
It's outside. It can't see in.
The glass fell! It heard us!
Out the back door! Full steam!
Keep the fire hot! Don't look back!
Ember Town! Lights ahead. Hold on!
It's still out there. It will be back.
